person.description: Index into persons[]. The filer this Form 1099-G was issued to — the primary, or the spouse on a joint return.

unemployment_compensation_cents.description: Box 1, unemployment compensation. Required: the form is issued because compensation was paid, so a blank box is an unread box, not compensation of nothing. Reaches Schedule 1 line 7 and, through Schedule 1 line 10 and Form 1040 line 8, line 9. Never negative.

federal_withholding_cents.description: Box 4, federal income tax withheld. Optional: blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Reaches Form 1040 line 25b, inside line 25d. Never negative.

repaid_cents.description: Unemployment compensation received in the year and repaid in the same year — the Schedule 1, line 7 repayment entry space, not a box on the form. Optional: absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Netted against box 1 on line 7. Never above box 1: a repayment exceeding the year's benefits is a repayment of an earlier year's benefits, which opens an itemized deduction (or the engine's own knockout above $3,000) this service does not carry, so it is refused rather than served as a zero line 7. Box 2 (state or local income tax refund) is not covered: it is computed as zero and published as an assumption.
